**Needs attention:** Test quality (2). Other reviewed categories look good.

- **Style consistency:** Style consistency looks good.

**Minor fixes needed.** Posted 2 inline findings.

review_comments.body:
🟡 Warning · Test Quality — **Four rows cover two code paths**

The ros/opengl legs contain no matmul, so ("ros","world") and ("opengl","world") exercise the same world-target permutation, and ("world","ros")/("world","opengl") the same world-origin one. Keep one row per branch.

🟡 Warning · Test Quality — **Assertion compares the function with itself**

`expected` comes from the same call, and the fixed path no longer reaches `torch.matmul`, so this reduces to f(x)==f(x) post-fix and already fails pre-fix via the NaN check. Drop it or compare against literal quaternions.
